openova.provider.description: AI provider for chat and agent runs.

enumDescriptions: The agent may not write files; every command asks first.
The agent writes only inside the workspace (.git and .openova stay protected).
No write restrictions (commands still follow the approval policy).
openova.sandbox.description: What the agent MAY do. Enforced at the application layer (no OS kernel sandbox on Windows).

enumDescriptions: Ask for any command that is not known-safe.
Let the agent work inside the sandbox; ask only for destructive or network escalations.
Never ask (destructive commands included — use with care).
openova.approval.description: When the agent asks before running commands. Independent from the sandbox axis.

openova.networkAccess.description: Allow network-reaching commands (curl, ssh, ping...) without approval. Off = they require approval.

openova.permissionMode.markdownDeprecationMessage: Superseded by `openova.sandbox` and `openova.approval` (auto maps to approval: never).

openova.model.description: Model id (discovered models are offered in the picker).

openova.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort for models that support it (off disables thinking on local models).

openova.baseUrl.description: Base URL override for the active provider.

openova.maxAgentSteps.description: Agent step budget per round. When it runs out the run pauses with a Continue button (context kept) instead of stopping.

openova.checkCommand.description: Optional command (typecheck/lint/test) the agent must pass before finishing.

openova.tabCompletion.description: Ghost-text tab completions from the configured model (Tab to accept).

openova.fallbackModels.description: Model fallback chain for agent runs, tried in order when the primary model fails (rate limit / outage). Entries are "provider:model" (e.g. "groq:llama-3.3-70b-versatile") or a bare model name on the current provider. Failed models cool down for 90s.

openova.modelPlan.description: Model used for Plan mode drafts, as "provider:model" or a bare model on the current provider. Empty = the main model.

openova.modelTitle.description: Model used to auto-title chats (a cheap/fast model is ideal). "provider:model" or bare model. Empty = the main model.

openova.modelCompletion.description: Model used for tab ghost-text completions (a small fast model is ideal, e.g. a local Qwen coder). "provider:model" or bare model. Empty = the main model.

openova.embeddings.description: Semantic codebase search. 'auto' uses a local embedding model when one is reachable (LM Studio or Ollama) and silently stays on keyword search otherwise; 'off' always uses keyword search. Nothing is sent to a cloud provider unless you point openova.embeddingBaseUrl at one.

openova.embeddingModel.description: Embedding model id (e.g. 'nomic-embed-text' on Ollama, 'text-embedding-nomic-embed-text-v1.5' on LM Studio). Empty auto-picks the first embedding model the server reports.

openova.embeddingBaseUrl.description: Embedding endpoint. Empty probes LM Studio (http://localhost:1234/v1) then Ollama (http://localhost:11434). A URL ending in /v1 is treated as OpenAI-compatible.

openova.embeddingWeight.description: Blend between keyword and semantic ranking for codebase_search: 0 is pure keyword (BM25), 1 is pure vector similarity.

openova.parallelRuns.description: How many attempts the Parallel chat mode runs at once. Each attempt gets its own git worktree; you keep one and the rest are discarded.

openova.budgetUSD.description: Soft session budget in USD (estimated). When a chat's estimated spend crosses it you get a warning; 0 disables. Estimates use ~4 chars/token and list prices — a gauge, not a bill.

openova.mcpServers.description: MCP servers available to the agent. Local stdio: { "name": "docs", "command": "npx some-mcp-server" }. Remote Streamable HTTP: { "name": "linear", "url": "https://mcp.example.com/mcp", "headers": { "authorization": "Bearer ..." } }.

command.description: Shell command for a local stdio server.

url.description: Endpoint of a remote Streamable HTTP server (used when set; command is ignored).

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers (e.g. authorization) sent to a remote server.
